description.value: Knights Inn Kamloops is an economy motel situated off the Trans-Canada Highway near Thompson Rivers University, offering straightforward, no-frills accommodation in a convenient location for travellers passing through Kamloops. The property provides free outdoor parking with large-vehicle spaces and free continental breakfast included with stays. Its proximity to Riverside Park and adventure outfitters like Adams River Rafting makes it a practical base for exploring the Thompson Valley.

address.value: 625 West Columbia Street, Kamloops, BC V2C 1K8
